description: This file defines the BuzzPostAPI class which handles API endpoints related to creating, retrieving, updating, and managing buzz posts in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for posting text, photos, and videos, as well as validation rules, transaction management, and integration with other system entities like BuzzShare, BuzzPhoto, and BuzzLink.

classes.name: BuzzPostAPI
classes.description: Handles API operations related to Buzz posts including creation, retrieval, updating, and validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of new Buzz posts with support for text, photos, and videos; manages database transactions and validation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Buzz post by ID, with support for different data models.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Buzz post, including modification of text, photos, and video links; manages deletions and full updates.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented for deleting Buzz posts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method based on post type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Method not implemented for getting validation rules for getAll.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single post by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a Buzz post.

methods.name: setBuzzPost
methods.description: Sets the main BuzzPost entity properties from request parameters.

methods.name: setBuzzShare
methods.description: Links and sets properties for a BuzzShare entity associated with a post.

methods.name: setBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Associates photos with a BuzzPost, validating and saving each photo.

methods.name: setBuzzVideoPost
methods.description: Creates and associates a BuzzLink for a video URL with a BuzzPost.

methods.name: getPhotoValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for photo attachments.

methods.name: getVideoValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for video link URLs.

methods.name: getTextValidationRuleForOtherPost
methods.description: Returns validation rules for optional text in non-text posts.

methods.name: getTextValidationRuleForTextPost
methods.description: Returns validation rules for required text in text posts.

methods.name: updateBuzzVideoPost
methods.description: Updates the BuzzLink entity with a new video URL.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which data model class to use based on request parameter.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Fetches a BuzzFeedPost object based on post ID.
